description:
Look up Japanese words, kanji, readings, meanings, conjugations, and example sentences in one focused dictionary.

Search in Japanese, English, or romaji. Open detailed entries, explore kanji components and stroke order, hear Japanese pronunciation, and save private notes and recent searches.

Use handwriting to find a kanji you cannot type. Import or photograph Japanese text to recognize selectable words, open dictionary entries, and create a natural English translation using Apple's system language features.

Zenbu Japanese works without an account. It has no ads, analytics, or cloud sync. Your searches, notes, and selected images stay on your iPhone.
promotionalText: Japanese dictionary, kanji lookup, handwriting, image text, and translation—without an account.
